pillar_reactions.evidence: No pillar content on this call. The nearest reference is logistical — 'he will tell me what kind of kettlebells to get' — which is equipment, not the training pillar.

Never presented as a pillar. The rep does offer informal personal follow-up — 'in a couple of weeks from now, I'm going to give you a call, send you a message, see how everything is going on WhatsApp' — but this is relationship maintenance, not the accountability pillar being delivered.

unmet_demand.want: Pay opportunistically through a reusable payment link whenever money comes in, rather than on a fixed monthly charge
unmet_demand.why_unmet: Billing runs on a standard payment link or a card charged on a schedule; the rep could not approve an ad-hoc or bi-weekly arrangement himself and had to escalate — 'I will ask my team, because I'm not the systems guy'.

unmet_demand.want: Bi-weekly instalments of roughly $500-$700 instead of $1,200 monthly
unmet_demand.why_unmet: No bi-weekly option exists in the offer; the rep signalled it would probably be fine before checking, so whether it is actually supported is unresolved at the end of the call.
